title: Design of a 60.8 K superconducting hydride LiMgZr2H12 at ambient pressure via lithium substitutional doping
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,29231-29239
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02577C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Qun Wei, Xinyu Wang, Jing Luo, Meiguang Zhang, Bing Wei
Inspired by MgZrH6, we designed the quaternary superhydride LiMgZr2H12 EPC calculations show that it is dynamically stable at ambient pressure and exhibits a superconducting Tc of 60.8 K.
